parameters.name: gatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud-native API gateway.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The service name for exact match query.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description:
The source type of the service. Valid values:

- MSE_NACOS: The service is from MSE Nacos.
- K8S: The service is from a Kubernetes cluster in Container Service.
- FC3: The service is from Function Compute.
- VIP: The service is from a fixed address.
- DNS: The service is from a domain name.

parameters.name: sourceTypes
parameters.description: The list of service source types.
